name: JK to Inkou Kyoushi SP ~Wataru Seken wa Ero Kyoushi Bakari~
original_name: JKと淫行教師SP～渡る世間はエロ教師ばかり～
source:
The protagonist is a 41-year-old teacher who pays for sex as a hobby. He’s obsessed with high school girls.
He spends his days hitting on the girls in the newspaper club he advises, or using dating forums to contact girls from other schools, taking them to hotels, and giving them “support” money—his code word for his shady activities.
One day, he finds a girl on a forum who matches his type and arranges to meet her. But it turns out to be a trap set by the newspaper club girls, who plan to expose him to the police!
Narrowly escaping the trap, the protagonist pins down the disguised girl on the bed, a sleazy grin spreading across his face.

“The going rate is ¥2,000 per round, with an extra ¥1,000 for the hymen and another ¥1,000 for finishing inside… right?”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ005802.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
主角是一位41岁的老师，以花钱买性为爱好。他迷恋高中女生。
他整天都在他建议的报社俱乐部里勾搭女孩，或者利用约会论坛联系其他学校的女孩，带她们去旅馆，给她们“赡养费”——这是他从事不正当活动的暗号。
有一天，他在论坛上发现了一位符合他类型的女孩，并安排与她见面。但事实证明这是报社女孩们设下的陷阱，她们打算向警方揭发他！
主角险些逃脱陷阱，将乔装打扮的女孩按倒在床上，脸上露出猥琐的笑容。

“现行价格是每轮2,000日元，处女膜的额外费用是1,000日元，内完成的费用是1,000日元……对吧？”
